senses.sense_definition: Having the learning disorder dyslexia, which causes difficulty with reading and spelling.

examples.text: Many <w>dyslexic</w> students benefit from using specialized fonts and extra time during exams.
It is important to support <w>dyslexic</w> children by providing them with appropriate learning tools.

senses.sense_definition: Relating to or characteristic of the condition of dyslexia.

examples.text: The teacher recognized the <w>dyslexic</w> patterns in the student's writing early in the term.
The school implemented new <w>dyslexic</w> friendly teaching methods to improve literacy rates.

senses.sense_definition: A person who has the learning disorder dyslexia.

examples.text: Many successful entrepreneurs are <w>dyslexics</w> who have learned to leverage their unique way of thinking.
Support groups provide a safe space for <w>dyslexics</w> to share their experiences and strategies.
